obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: In the universe of terminating finite fixture runs and pass/fail reports, absent pairs are false acceptance or false rejection relative to the assertion conjunction. Abort and nontermination are excluded; finite observations support only this scope.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations

obernants.observation_scope: Values, shape, errors and named assertions
obernants.operator: A pass admits all candidate implementations agreeing on the finite fixtures, including arbitrary off-fixture differences. Failure admits defective production or defective oracle. Neither observation uniquely recovers a cause.
obernants.assumptions: Prime field, declared resource domain and successful allocations
